biocontainers.name: circlator
biocontainers.summary: Circlator: a tool to circularise genome assemblies

biotools.summary: Circlator is a tool to circularize genome assemblies. It will attempt to identify each circular sequence and output a linearised version of it. It does this by assembling all reads that map to contig ends and comparing the resulting contigs with the input assembly.
